<!--
The title is a conventional commit and becomes the squashed commit:
`<type>(<scope>): <subject>`, lower case after the colon, no final period,
no angle brackets, at most 72 characters; `!` before the colon for a
breaking change.

The body: what changed, as one-line bullets in the past tense under the
headings that apply (Features, Fixes, Performance, Documentation, Refactor,
Tests, Chores, Quality). Delete the headings you do not use. Name any change
made outside the repository, such as a setting or a secret. Add a last
"Heads-up:" line only when behaviour changes or users must migrate.
-->
